caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a light beige background, with no other elements or textures present. The depicted object is a spur illustrated in brown, gray, and metallic tones. The body of the spur consists of a brown, curved arm with a textured surface, attached to a decorated, straight metal shank adorned with multiple round metal studs colored in shades of silver and gray. Near the center, there is a large circular medallion with a blue and white marbled pattern. The shank extends to a circular wheel, or rowel, composed of a flat, metallic disk with multiple evenly spaced, pointed spokes radiating outward, all rendered in shades of gray. The object also features additional small, round metal elements and subtle engraved patterns. There are three symmetrical, trilobed attachments, rendered in brown and silver, at the bottom and rear end of the object. The composition is isolated on the page, with the object being the only item drawn, surrounded by ample empty space.
title: Spur
